svg.title: For a marked team, remove the team’s selected keys from p and multiply that remaining body by its paid ingredient product. Each paid leaf ingredient has absolute value bounded by its assigned leaf weight, so their product is bounded by the team weight WM. If the team keys are not all in p, define the term to be zero. Otherwise the preceding argument gives the marked bound Z Y |markedBodyM,p| ≤WM ti. i∈p\keys(M)
